# EventCameraTemporalPipeline

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A processing pipeline that integrates event camera outputs with spiking neural networks to handle asynchronous, high-temporal-resolution visual data. Bridges event-based sensing and spike-based computation, a core requirement for real-time, low-latency TCC and iNEST systems.
